w:r.w:t: Validation Engine Hardening & Industry Intelligence System
Phase 1 built the app scaffold, database, and execution loop.
Phase 2 enforced blueprint tier selection, mode selection, hierarchy, and feature gating.
Phase 3 now hardens the most critical pre-execution gate: VALIDATION.
The current risk is that validation is either:
cosmetic — shows output without real intelligence
generic — does not know the user's industry
shallow — does not show everything relevant to the goal
disconnected — does not feed correctly into blueprint generation
incomplete — missing the full intelligence systems the spec requires
Validation is the ONLY moment before execution where reality can stop a bad direction. If validation is weak, the entire blueprint is built on wrong assumptions.
⚖ CORE LAW — Validation is a reality gate, not a feature. It must be intelligent, industry-specific, and tier-aware.
⚖ CORE LAW — The 5 AI intelligence systems (CIS, IIS, EIS, SIS, PIS) must ALL run during validation.
⚖ CORE LAW — Validation output MUST feed directly into blueprint structure. No disconnected generation.
⚖ CORE LAW — Validation must show the user EVERYTHING relevant to their industry BEFORE they commit to a blueprint.
⚖ CORE LAW — A user cannot launch a blueprint if: verdict = Pivot Required OR a critical risk remains unresolved.
⚖ CORE LAW — AI interprets and surfaces intelligence. Reality signals and conditions remain the authority.

PHASE 2 — BUILD THE EIS (EXTERNAL INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM)
The EIS is the most critical missing piece in validation. It is what makes Torgima feel like a real intelligence system, not a generic AI tool.
The EIS monitors and interprets real-world conditions OUTSIDE of Torgima.
Track macro trends — industry-level shifts, platform changes, economic movements
Track micro trends — niche-level patterns, audience behavior, content or product performance
Monitor demand signals — rising, stable, or declining interest in the user's space
Identify saturation — is this industry / niche / offer oversaturated?
Identify opportunity — where is there real unmet demand in this space?
Observe competitor movement — what are the top players doing?
Detect platform changes — algorithm shifts, policy changes, platform growth or decline
Identify strategic windows — timing, market gaps, entry points
Update demand signal → inject into validation output
Issue warning → flag in risk panel → may trigger Adjust verdict
Flag competitive risk → recommend differentiation path
Flag execution risk → may affect target structure
Alert user → update strategic path recommendations
Inject into IIS → refine execution approach
Surface in Alternative Path panel → recommend timing
EIS uses the Bhudhi AI layer to synthesize intelligence from:
Web search results for the industry and niche
Historical demand data for the domain

IMPORTANT: EIS runs at validation time using live AI inference (Bhudhi web search). It does NOT use static hardcoded data. Every validation call must produce fresh industry intelligence specific to the user's goal and domain.

PHASE 10 — BHUDHI ROLE IN VALIDATION (BOUNDARIES ENFORCED)
Bhudhi is the AI layer. It runs the intelligence systems. It generates validation content. But it has strict boundaries.
10.1 What Bhudhi Is ALLOWED to Do in Validation
Run CIS: understand and map the goal context
Run IIS: refine and strengthen the goal
Run EIS: research the industry and surface intelligence
Run SIS: evaluate strategic fit and generate paths
Run PIS: predict risks and outcomes
Generate all validation output text: tabs, panels, paths, risk explanations
Explain the verdict in user-friendly language
Suggest what inputs to change if the verdict is ADJUST or PIVOT
10.2 What Bhudhi is FORBIDDEN from Doing in Validation
Override a PIVOT REQUIRED verdict to allow blueprint launch
Mark validation as complete when it has not run
Generate a path without running EIS first
Fabricate demand data or competitor intelligence
Change the verdict based on user pushback
Skip feasibility evaluation because the user 'seems confident'
Allow an incomplete goal to pass validation

BHUDHI RULE: If the user argues with the verdict, Bhudhi explains the reasoning more clearly. It cannot change the verdict. Signals and reality determine the verdict. Bhudhi interprets — it does not override.
